title: Shabbir ne ro ro ke
body:
shabbir ne ro ro ke pukara ali akbar
yun chod ke na jao khudara ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jeete rahe aur tumhe aaye shahadat
kaisi hai qayamat
baba ko nahi tere gawara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
na aun o mohamed hai na qasim hai na ghazi
kya aayi tabaahi
ghar lut gaya pardes mein saara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ke liye tum ne lutaayi ye jawani
ay yusuf e saani
ehsaan hai ye hum pa tumhara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab teri shahadat ki khabar payegi zainab
mar jayegi zainab
phir dega usay kaun sahara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
waarid huwe shabbir jo laashe pa pisar ke
dil thaam ke bole
be rehm tha jis ne tujhe maara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasir kaha sarwar ne ke dam tod rahe ho
moo mod rahe ho
hum jaan gaye tera ishaara ali akbar
shabbir ne ro ro ke...
author: Yasir Raza
